references.text: Levi's genealogy showing Aaron's position as head of the tribe of Levi, which explains why his name is written on Levi's staff.
The names of Aaron's sons who were anointed as priests, linking Aaron to leadership within the tribe of Levi.
The preceding verse explaining that there shall be one staff for each tribal leader, providing context for why Aaron's name should stand on Levi's staff.
The result of Aaron's staff being laid down and sprouting, confirming his selection as leader of the tribe of Levi.
The New Testament refers to Aaron's staff that sprouted, linking it to the ark of the covenant and the Levitical priesthood.
